# 2026 Summits at a Glance

In 2026, the **R/Pharma Summit is happening twice** — once in the US alongside posit::conf(2026), and once in Europe at the Novartis Pavilion in Basel.

Both events bring pharma leaders and practitioners together for a full day of focused roundtable discussions on AI, validated computing environments, scalable infrastructure, and regulatory compliance.

# Roundtable Discussions

The roundtable topics are shared and discussed openly — and feed into **both** the US and EU summits. We strongly encourage the whole community to help shape the agenda before either event.

::: {.callout-important}
## 💬 Help Shape the Agenda — Vote and Comment Now!

All proposed roundtable topics are collected in one place on GitHub Discussions:

👉 **[github.com/rinpharma/rinpharma-summit-2026/discussions](https://github.com/rinpharma/rinpharma-summit-2026/discussions)**

You can:

- **Browse** proposed topics
- **Upvote** the ones that matter most to you
- **Comment** to add context, refine the scope, or pitch a new topic

*The more voices we hear before the events, the better the conversations on the day — please get involved!*

Notes and outcomes from past roundtables are shared openly at [rinpharma.com/docs/summit/](https://rinpharma.com/docs/summit/).
:::

# Background

In 2018 and 2019, **R in Pharma** was in-person at Harvard University and focused on opportunities for direct interaction with speakers and guests.
These relationships and connections have grown into many exciting areas of Open Source drug development.

- In **2023** we partnered with *Posit*, hosting an in-person session at posit::conf(2023) in Chicago.
- In **2024**, the session continued at posit::conf(2024) in Seattle.
- In **2025**, we hosted a summit at posit::conf(2025) in Atlanta.

::: callout-important
In **2026** we're expanding for the first time to **two events** — bringing the R/Pharma Summit to both the US and Europe! 🎉
:::

---

# Purpose

Over the last five years we've seen explosive growth in the use of R, Python, and other open-source technologies across drug development — with an accelerating focus on **AI**.

The R/Pharma Summit provides an **open, collaborative, and inclusive environment** to foster in-person discussions on key topics:

- AI in drug development
- Validated computing environments
- Scalable infrastructure
- Regulatory compliance and submissions

The Summit builds on what R/Pharma started at Harvard in 2018 — bringing people into a room to start the conversations that matter. It unites thought leaders and decision makers to discuss AI, open source, and pharma. Notes and actions are shared openly with the community.

> 🔗 Review the 2023–2025 roundtable summaries here:  
> [rinpharma.github.io/roundtables](https://rinpharma.github.io/roundtables/)

---

# Audience

These summits are for you if:

- You are an active contributor to the adoption of data science best practices across drug development
- You sponsor data science codebases
- You are an informatics professional designing and implementing **GxP-conforming** data science platforms
- You are interested in cross-pharma collaboration

# US Summit — September 13, Houston

## Venue

**Hilton Americas-Houston**  
Houston, Texas, USA

*Held on Sunday, September 13, 2026 — the day before posit::conf(2026) workshops begin.* This is a full-day roundtable event bringing together 80–100 pharma leaders and practitioners. Organized by the non-profit Open-Source in Pharma, including representatives from several large pharmaceutical companies.

## Registration

::: {.callout-note}
**Tickets** are \$599 as a standalone ticket, or available as an **add-on with a posit::conf(2026) conference pass**.

👉 [Register at conf.posit.co/2026/registration](https://conf.posit.co/2026/registration)

To attend the Summit without a full conference pass, contact [conf@posit.co](mailto:conf@posit.co) for assistance.
:::
